issues.t: Timing chain stretch
issues.sym: Check engine light, rattling at cold start, rough idle, misfires or reduced power.
issues.why: The timing chains on the 3.6 V6 can stretch over time, most often when oil changes are overdue. GM issued updated parts and extended coverage on some early years.
issues.next: Have timing codes and noises checked right away to prevent engine damage, and keep up with oil changes using the correct oil.

issues.t: Lost 3rd, 5th and reverse gears
issues.sym: No reverse, missing gears, shuddering, or a check engine light.
issues.why: A wave plate in the six-speed automatic can break and damage other parts. GM updated the part and offered extended coverage, which has since ended.
issues.next: Have the transmission diagnosed by a shop familiar with this issue. Do not drive with severe slipping.

issues.t: Power steering pump leaks and whine
issues.sym: Squealing or whining when turning, stiff steering at low speeds, or fluid leaks.
issues.why: The power steering pump and gear on early Enclaves can leak and fail. GM extended coverage for some of these years.
issues.next: Check the fluid level and have leaks repaired before the pump runs dry.

issues.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall)
issues.sym: Service Air Bag message or airbag light, sometimes when the seats are moved.
issues.why: Side airbag wiring under the seats can develop high resistance and may keep the side airbags and pretensioners from working. GM recalled these vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the free repair.

issues.t: Power liftgate struts wear and gate drops (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate will not stay up, drifts down, or the power motor struggles.
issues.why: Worn gas struts can let an open liftgate fall unexpectedly. GM recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and do not stand under an open gate until it is fixed.

issues.t: A/C evaporator leaks
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm, cycles between cold and warm, or the A/C button blinks.
issues.why: Front and rear evaporators on these SUVs commonly leak. A bulletin tied some rear evaporator failures to debris shed by the blower motor.
issues.next: Have the system leak-tested rather than simply recharged.

issues.t: Heated windshield washer module can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, or washers that stop working.
issues.why: The heated washer fluid module can short circuit and overheat, which is a fire risk. GM first added a fuse and later removed the module altogether.
issues.next: Check your VIN for these recalls right away. If you smell burning under the hood, stop and have it inspected.

issues.t: Wiper linkage can fail under snow or ice (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers stop moving or move out of step, often after heavy snow or ice on the windshield.
issues.why: The wiper linkage can come apart when the wipers are loaded with snow or ice.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and do not drive in rain or snow with wipers that do not work.

issues.t: Wiper arms can loosen under snow or ice (recall)
issues.sym: One or both wiper arms stop sweeping while the motor still runs.
issues.why: The nuts that hold the wiper arms can loosen when the wipers are blocked by snow or ice.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and do not drive in rain or snow with wipers that do not work.

issues.t: Front seat belt cable can break (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The belt may feel loose where it anchors to the seat.
issues.why: The steel cable that ties the front seat belt to the seat can fatigue and separate, so the belt may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and get the free repair done promptly.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing defect can make the driver airbag inflator burst when it deploys and throw metal pieces into the cabin.
issues.next: Check your VIN for these recalls and get the free repair as soon as parts are available.

issues.t: Chassis control module can short out (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights or electrical faults, and possibly a stall or no-start.
issues.why: The chassis electronic module may have been contaminated inside when it was built and can short circuit. GM recalled affected vehicles to replace it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the module replaced promptly.

issues.t: Start/stop accumulator end cap may be missing bolts (recall)
issues.sym: Transmission fluid leaking, shifting problems, or a loss of drive.
issues.why: The end cap on the transmission accumulator used by the automatic stop/start system may have been fitted without all of its bolts, so it can leak fluid.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. Stop driving if you see fluid leaking or the vehicle stops pulling.

issues.t: Right front frame rail may be cracked (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can see or feel from the driver seat.
issues.why: The right-hand frame rail in the engine compartment may have a crack from manufacturing, which can weaken the structure in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the dealer inspect the rail promptly.

issues.t: Fuel pump nozzle may be blocked and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Hesitation, a stall while driving, or an engine that cranks but will not start.
issues.why: A burr left from manufacturing can block a nozzle inside the fuel pump and starve the engine of fuel.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the fuel pump replaced promptly. A stall in traffic is a safety risk.

issues.t: Roof-rail airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign. An airbag light is possible.
issues.why: A part of the roof-rail airbag inflator can separate, and on some vehicles a wiring connector has the wrong terminals, so the side curtain airbags may not protect as designed.
issues.next: Check your VIN for these recalls and get the free repair done promptly.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not be properly attached (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing, though an airbag warning light can come on.
issues.why: The roof-rail curtain airbags may not have been fastened correctly, so they may not protect the way they should in a rollover or side crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the attachment corrected free.

issues.t: Wiper motor can overheat and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers that slow down or stop, a hot plastic smell, or smoke from the base of the windshield.
issues.why: The wiper motor can overheat in use.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall now. If you smell hot plastic from the cowl, stop using the wipers and park outside.

issues.t: Third-row seat frame welds may be in the wrong place (recall)
issues.sym: The third-row seat may feel loose or move more than it should.
issues.why: The lower seat frame was welded in the wrong locations, so the seat may not hold up in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the seat frame replaced free.

issues.t: Original Goodyear tires can crack in the tread (recall)
issues.sym: Cracks or splits in the tread grooves, vibration, or a sudden loss of air.
issues.why: These original-equipment tires can crack in the tread and fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the tires replaced free before driving at highway speed.

issues.t: Front airbag software may be wrongly calibrated (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom you can see, and often no warning light.
issues.why: Incorrect frontal airbag calibration software may have been loaded during dealer service, which can change how the airbags deploy.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the correct software installed free.

issues.t: Electronic owner's manual may be missing from the screen (recall)
issues.sym: The owner's manual cannot be found on the center display.
issues.why: The radio was not set at the factory to download the electronic owner's manual, which the vehicle is required to carry.
issues.next: Mention it at your next dealer visit; the fix is a radio setting. It does not affect how the vehicle drives.
